Market today: The mood is cautious, with a major firm warning of worsening risk-reward and rising mortgage rates pushing oil prices up. These factors are headwinds for your tech/chip heavy, growth-oriented portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -56% and flagged SELL; its leveraged decay is amplified by margin. SPAL, a new leveraged position, is also down significantly at -38%. SMH (-12.76%) and QQQI (-3.39%) are flagged TRIM. Remember, margin amplifies drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on interest rate movements and oil prices, as they directly impact tech valuations. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) closely for further decay or stop breaches.

Bottom line: Focus on aggressive risk management and protecting capital in this cautious market.
plays: Address SOXL immediately; its -56% loss and leveraged decay are amplified by margin. Consider exiting or tightening its stop.
Review SPAL, a new leveraged position down -38%. Respect its stop at 21.38 to prevent further deep drawdowns.
Trim SMH and QQQI as indicated by the scanner to reduce overall tech/chip exposure in this cautious environment.
